reason: The primary CIF is valid: it parses as a primitive 10-site, fully occupied K4NaCl5 cell (305.119 A^3), symmetry-detects as C2/m despite its explicit P1 encoding, is charge balanced, has no overlaps, and gives complete sixfold unlike-ion coordination. However, the exact atomic realization is not sufficiently established. The trace exhaustively assumes an ideal index-5 rocksalt ordering and refines only four lattice parameters plus profile nuisance parameters; it does not recover or refine any internal atomic coordinates. The submitted coordinates predict low-angle superstructure lines at 9.368, 12.320, and 13.872 degrees (calculated relative intensities 1.565, 0.849, and 0.647) that are not resolved above the approximately 0.10 intensity noise, with integrated deficits well beyond noise, while multiple observed weak superstructure intensities are also mismatched. The reported global profile RMS of 0.0818 is not accompanied by a comparable Rwp or residual audit and is dominated by accurately fitted parent-rocksalt reflections, so it does not reject a materially different same-indexed-cell realization with relaxed C2/m internal coordinates or symmetry lowering. That concrete branch remains viable and warrants another attempt.
